[element-intro-title-wrap]
=== `<intro-title-wrap>` Introductory Title Wrapper

Wrapper element to collect together the <<element-intro,`<intro>`>> title of the standard and its related component parts, such as a label or subtitle(s).

#### Related Elements

*Parts of an Introductory Title:* A simple introductory title should be tagged using the <<element-intro,`<intro>`>> element. If the introductory title has a label or subtitles, the `<intro-title-wrap>` element is used to hold all the introductory title components together.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-level,`@level`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>

* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-title-wrap,`<title-wrap>`>>
#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-label,`<label>`>> <<element-label,Label of a Figure, Reference, Etc.>>, zero or one <<element-intro,`<intro>`>> <<element-intro,Introductory Title Part>> <<element-subtitle,`<subtitle>`>> <<element-subtitle,Article Subtitle>>, zero or more
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  intro-title-wrap
                        %intro-title-wrap-model;                     >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(label?, intro, subtitle*)

#### Tagged Sample

##### Introductory title and subtitle are wrapped together in `<intro-title-wrap>`
[source,xml]
....
...
<title-wrap>
 <intro-title-wrap>
  <intro>2015 ASME Boiler Pressure Vessel Code</intro>
  <subtitle>An International Code</subtitle>
 </intro-title-wrap>
 <main-title-wrap>
  <label>I</label>
  <main>Rules for Construction of Power Boilers</main> 
 </main-title-wrap>
 <full>2015 ASME Boiler Pressure Vessel Code, An International 
  Code, Section I: Rules for Construction of Power Boilers</full>
</title-wrap>
...
....
